name: ai-code-skills
description: Agent Skills for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode that review code for security, performance, and clean code, then write one evidence-based Markdown report. Includes Next.js/React and Laravel/PHP pull-request reviewers, a stack-agnostic pre-push reviewer that scores your local changes (Security, Performance, Clean Code) as Pass/Warn/Fail with a push-readiness verdict, a developer-focused technical SEO + GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) auditor that produces a per-page README report with code-level fixes, and a delegate dispatcher that hands a task to another model's CLI (Codex, OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini) headlessly and summarizes the result. Pick which skills to install.

scripts.test: node bin/cli.js list >/dev/null && node bin/cli.js --help >/dev/null && python3 skills/nextjs-pr-review/scripts/validate-report.py --self-test && python3 skills/laravel-pr-review/scripts/validate-report.py --self-test && python3 skills/pre-push-review/scripts/validate-report.py --self-test && python3 skills/technical-seo-geo-audit/scripts/validate-report.py --self-test && node skills/technical-seo-geo-audit/scripts/selftest.mjs && bash -n skills/delegate/scripts/detect-clis.sh && bash -n skills/delegate/scripts/delegate.sh && bash skills/delegate/scripts/delegate.sh --help >/dev/null && bash skills/delegate/scripts/detect-clis.sh >/dev/null

author: Ezzat Malak
